_how: Copy to metrics.json. Each measure appears on the view named in 'view' (overview, detection, vulnerabilities, remediation, email, people, controls) as a headline tile and a 12-week chart. Sources: 'csv' reads a column from a file in the data folder, 'kql' runs a Sentinel query that returns week_ending and value, 'static' takes the values as written.

source.query: SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(84d) and AlertName has 'ransom' | summarize value = dcount(SystemAlertId) by week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | order by week_ending asc

metrics.label: Security training completed
metrics.note: Example only: replace with your learning platform's export.
